reference: RQ-LIMEN-2026-A008; recurring defect class DC-005 (stale mutable reads served from the browser HTTP cache), observed in indy-init Rehearsals 2 and 3
placement: An optional, explicit cache mode on the existing Core Http effect request, protocol 1.5, modelled exactly like the 1.3 credentials option: a contract enum HttpCacheMode and an optional HttpEffectRequest.cache field in contract/core.contract.json, every language binding regenerated by tools/contract-gen, and the kernel passing the mode to fetch's cache init unchanged. Absent means today's request. The kernel decides nothing: whether a read may be cached is the engine's policy. No new capability family, binding primitive, Core file, root export family, dependency or guardrail change.
